answer: Self-dealing is the cheap way to fake a reputation, so make it burn money. Only jobs paid through the protocol count toward standing, and every payment destroys a slice as a fee. A freelancer with an opal-bright record earned it because strangers paid for quill work. A farm trading jobs among its own names pays that fee on every loop, and standing bought on one name never transfers to another, so each fake climbs toward the horizon at the farm's own expense.
